senses.gloss:
‘alaṅkāragrantha’_(?)
fr. only 8 lines on part of Upamā; in one verse the name ‘Candrāloka’ occurs (alaGkRtpuMbhiH sAndraH candrAlokaH prakIrttaye). Oxf. II. 274 (3).

‘Ālambanapratyayadhyānaśāstra’
name in the Chinese transl. of Diṅnāga's Ālambanaparīkṣā. See Nanjio 1173-4. [Page182-b]
